tagline.zh: 点击或拖拽把文件交给系统:上传中带百分比进度、成功打勾、失败给修复指引——每个文件在列表里走完自己的状态机。
tagline.en: Hand files to the system by click or drag: uploading shows a percent bar, success ticks, failure gives repair guidance — each file walks its own state machine in the list.

origin.zh: 上传组件的两条一手参照线:IBM Carbon File Uploader(调研 07§14)——按钮/拖放两变体、拖入时边框变色加粗、**上传中文件三态 loading/success/uploaded**、错误态要给清晰修复指引、标题描述上传区用途、描述写明大小/格式限制、长文件名省略号+tooltip、键盘 Space/Enter 打开选择框且关闭后焦点回触发元素;Ant Design Upload(补研 12§15)——文件 status 四值 uploading(进度条)/done/error/removed、beforeUpload 返回 false 阻止上传、maxCount=1 时替换当前文件、Upload.Dragger 拖拽容器。demo 五态 = 入口(点击/拖拽)+ 拖拽悬停 + Carbon 三态映射 antd status(2026-11-20/22 抓取一手文档)。
origin.en: Two primary-source lines anchor the upload: IBM Carbon File Uploader (research 07 §14) — button/dropzone variants, border color+thicken on drag-in, **three states for files being uploaded: loading/success/uploaded**, error states demand clear repair guidance, the heading describes the zone's purpose, the description states size/format limits, long filenames ellipsize with a tooltip, and Space/Enter opens the dialog with focus returning to the trigger; Ant Design Upload (supplementary study 12 §15) — file status uploading (progress bar)/done/error/removed, beforeUpload returning false blocks upload, maxCount=1 replaces the current file, Upload.Dragger as the drag container. The demo's five states = entry (click/drag) + drag hover + Carbon's three states mapped onto antd status (primary docs captured 2026-11-20/22).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换入口形态)。对应 Carbon File Uploader 的两变体(按钮触发文件选择对话框 / 拖放 drop zone,调研 07§14)与 antd Upload 的 Upload.Dragger(补研 12§15);变体官方默认值调研未记载,demo 默认 dropzone 为演示选择(拖拽态只在 dropzone 下可演示)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes to switch the entry form). Maps to Carbon File Uploader's two variants (button-triggered dialog / drag-drop zone, research 07 §14) and antd's Upload.Dragger (12 §15); the official default is unrecorded — the demo defaults to dropzone as a demo choice (drag states are only demonstrable there).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后控制模拟上传的结局:成功→done 打勾;失败→约 60% 处转 error + 修复指引)。这是 demo 教学开关,非组件 API——用于演示 antd file.status 的 done/error 分支(补研 12§15)与 Carbon 错误态「清晰修复指引」要求(调研 07§14)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes to control the simulated upload outcome: success → done with a tick; failure → flips to error with repair guidance around 60%). A demo teaching switch, not a component API — it exercises antd file.status done/error branches (12 §15) and Carbon's 'clear repair guidance' error-state requirement (research 07 §14).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后限制列表文件数,超出给出提示不再添加)。对应 antd Upload 的 maxCount——官方记载 =1 时替换当前文件(补研 12§15);默认值调研未记载,demo 默认 3 为演示教学值。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes to cap the list length, refusing extras with a notice). Maps to antd Upload's maxCount — officially recorded to replace the current file at =1 (12 §15); the default is unrecorded — the demo default of 3 is a demo teaching value.

note.zh: 上传入口是原生 <input type="file">(视觉隐藏,经 label/button 触发)+ dragover/drop 事件:文件对话框与文件系统访问全平台可用;DataTransfer 拖拽是 DOM 标准事件;进度条动画用 CSS width 过渡(教学模拟,生产应监听真实上传进度)。demo 不真正发送网络请求。
note.en: The entry is a native <input type="file"> (visually hidden, triggered via label/button) plus dragover/drop events: the file dialog and filesystem access work on every platform; DataTransfer drag is standard DOM; the progress bar animates via CSS width transitions (a teaching simulation — production should listen to real upload progress). The demo sends no network requests.

fallback.zh: 拖拽不可用(触屏/不支持 DataTransfer)时按钮路径完全兜底;无 JS 环境退化为原生 <input type="file"> + 表单提交;模拟进度应换成真实上传进度回调(antd onChange event.percent,补研 12§15),无进度回调的上传按 NN/g 准则:2–10s 用 spinner、≥10s 才需要 percent-done 进度条(调研 07§19)。
fallback.en: When drag is unavailable (touch / no DataTransfer) the button path fully covers it; in no-JS environments degrade to a native <input type="file"> plus form submit; the simulated progress should be replaced by real upload progress callbacks (antd onChange event.percent, supplementary study 12 §15); uploads without progress callbacks follow NN/g guidance: spinners for 2–10s, percent-done bars only at ≥10s (research 07 §19).

use.zh: 头像/封面等单文件上传:maxCount=1,新选即替换(antd maxCount=1 语义,补研 12§15)
use.en: Single-file uploads like avatars/covers: maxCount=1, a new pick replaces (antd maxCount=1 semantics, 12 §15)

use.zh: 附件/凭证批量上传:列表逐文件展示状态,失败可单独重试
use.en: Batch attachment/proof uploads: per-file status rows, individual retry on failure

use.zh: 拖拽为主的资料导入:从桌面/邮件客户端整批拖入
use.en: Drag-first data imports: whole batches dragged from desktop/mail clients

use.zh: 需要即时校验的导入:beforeUpload 式前置校验(格式/大小)不合格即拦截并给出修复指引(Carbon 错误态要求,调研 07§14)
use.en: Imports needing upfront validation: beforeUpload-style checks (format/size) that block and guide (Carbon error-state requirement, research 07 §14)

avoid.zh: 模态框里上传多个文件——列表纵向堆叠放不下(Carbon 明确警告,调研 07§14)
avoid.en: Uploading multiple files inside a modal — the stacked list won't fit (explicit Carbon warning, research 07 §14)

avoid.zh: 上传无任何进度反馈的静默等待——任何动作发起都要立即给视觉反馈(NN/g,调研 07§19)
avoid.en: Silent waits with no progress feedback — every initiated action needs immediate visual feedback (NN/g, research 07 §19)

avoid.zh: 隐藏文件类型/大小限制——描述必须写明大小/格式限制(Carbon 内容规范,调研 07§14)
avoid.en: Hiding type/size limits — the description must state size/format limits (Carbon content spec, research 07 §14)

avoid.zh: 失败只显示红叉不给修复指引——错误态要给清晰修复指引(Carbon,调研 07§14)
avoid.en: A bare red cross on failure — error states demand clear repair guidance (Carbon, research 07 §14)

a11y.zh: 入口是视觉隐藏的原生 <input type="file">,由按钮/拖拽区以点击或 Space/Enter 打开文件选择框(Carbon 键盘要求,调研 07§14;MUI 的 label+隐藏 input 模式,调研 07§1),对话框关闭后焦点自然回到触发元素(Carbon,调研 07§14);文件列表用 ul/li,行内删除按钮可 Tab 到达、Space/Enter 删除(Carbon 键盘路径,调研 07§14);长文件名省略号 + title 提示全名(Carbon,调研 07§14);每个文件的状态以可见文字表达(上传中 60% / 已完成 / 失败),进度条只是冗余视觉,不依赖颜色单独传达;状态变化经 aria-live 区域播报。
a11y.en: The entry is a visually hidden native <input type="file"> opened by click or Space/Enter on the button/dropzone (Carbon keyboard requirement, research 07 §14; MUI's label + hidden input pattern, research 07 §1), with focus returning naturally to the trigger after the dialog closes (Carbon, 07 §14); the file list is ul/li with row delete buttons reachable by Tab and activated by Space/Enter (Carbon keyboard path, 07 §14); long filenames ellipsize with a title tooltip for the full name (Carbon, 07 §14); every file's state is visible text (uploading 60% / done / failed) — the bar is redundant visuals and color never alone carries state; state changes announce through an aria-live region.

goal.zh: 复刻一个五态上传组件:拖拽区(拖入边框变色加粗)+ 文件列表,文件依次经历 uploading(百分比进度条)→ done(✓)或 error(✕ + 修复指引 + 重试),支持删除(removed)、maxCount 上限提示与长文件名省略号。
goal.en: Replicate a five-state uploader: a dropzone (border color+thicken on drag-in) plus a file list where each file walks uploading (percent bar) → done (✓) or error (✕ + repair guidance + retry), with delete (removed), maxCount capping and long-name ellipsis.

acceptance.zh: 入口为视觉隐藏的 <input type="file"> + 按钮/拖拽区,Space/Enter 可开文件框,拖拽 dragover 时边框变色加粗
acceptance.en: Entry = visually hidden <input type="file"> + button/dropzone, Space/Enter opens the dialog, dragover repaints the border thicker and colored

acceptance.zh: 文件状态机严格走 uploading(百分比)→ done/error;error 行附修复指引文案与重试按钮
acceptance.en: The file state machine strictly runs uploading (percent) → done/error; error rows carry repair guidance copy and a retry button

acceptance.zh: 删除按钮可 Tab 到达、Space/Enter 激活;长文件名省略号 + title 全名
acceptance.en: Delete buttons are Tab-reachable and Space/Enter activated; long names ellipsize with a title tooltip

acceptance.zh: maxCount 严格用参数快照值,超出即提示不再添加;列表语义 ul/li,状态变化经 aria-live 播报
acceptance.en: maxCount uses the exact snapshot value, refusing extras with a notice; list semantics ul/li; state changes announce via aria-live

acceptance.zh: 模拟上传约 1.5s(教学时长);进度条动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion;拖拽不可用时按钮路径完整可用
acceptance.en: Simulated uploads run ~1.5s (teaching duration); bar animation honors prefers-reduced-motion; with drag unavailable the button path fully works
